notes.title: Regency Solitaire II Multi-Language Update!
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/33035039/e7f0487fc5cbd3a045c7d50f6b0faab1798668ed.png[/img]

You can now [b]change language[/b] for Regency Solitaire II on Steam via the options screen.

Supported languages are: English, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Dutch, and Brazilian Portuguese.

Note: at present we have no plans to officially support more languages because we are an indie microstudio. But we welcome fan translations.

Enjoy playing Regency Solitaire II in your chosen language!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2137470/Regency_Solitaire_II/

[h1]Coming Oct 26th![/h1]

[b]Search the dark, cobwebby corners of every last level for gems and coins and make your hair stand on end with Jewel Match Twilight 3!

Features:
- Explore 180 huge levels!
- 55 additional bonus levels with new game features!
- 3 different playmodes: timed, relaxed, and moves limited!
- 2 difficulty settings: normal and veteran.
- Restore 9 eerie scenes.
- Buy dozens of upgrades and power-ups from the shop.
- Replayable mini-games games, including jigsaw and hidden object scenes.
- Beautiful wallpapers.
- Haunting soundtrack. [/b]

[h1]T-Minus 30 has been updated to V1.03 [/h1]

[b]Updated features:[/b]
- Opening a build menu category now auto-selects the top item in that category.
- Food now shows % of demand met next to quantity.
- Added hotkey L for Lookout Post
